label: DS3231 Backup Clock Demo
info: An Inject node fires every 10 seconds, triggering the periph-ds3231 node to read the current date/time and temperature. A one-shot Inject node (firing shortly after deploy) sends msg.payload.datetime built from the host's Date.now(), synchronizing the RTC to the host clock. The node is configured with Alarm 1 enabled in "once per minute" mode (seconds match, at :00); each time it fires, the node emits a separate {source: "alarm1"} message. A single Function node formats either shape of message into a log line, and a Debug node prints it — showing the interrupt-driven alarm path alongside the polled read in one flow.
